why: An arXiv preprint (2607.15632, submitted July 2026) by Tao Zhang claims both directions of Fuglede's conjecture fail in dimension two, via explicit finite-group counterexamples lifted to bounded unions of unit squares in R^2; this directly targets the R and R^2 case the bullet asks about, which had been the last open dimension (counterexamples already known for d>=3).
